construction.implementation_origin: New standalone implementation created for this build; no copied repository code.

input.query: String, maximum 300 characters. Blank browses the catalog.
input.products: Array of up to 1000 products. Required: unique string id, name, category, finite nonnegative price, boolean in_stock. Optional: description and array of tags.
input.filters: Optional object: category (case-insensitive exact), min_price, max_price (inclusive), in_stock (boolean). All prices must share a caller-selected currency.

shared_schema.success: status=ok, original query, normalized_tokens, mode, total_matches before limiting, results with product, score, and token matches.
shared_schema.error: status=error, error object with code=invalid_input and message; CLI exits 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function used by search and CLI; rejects unknown fields, invalid types, duplicate product ids, inverted ranges, nonfinite prices. CLI additionally rejects duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated input -> normalization -> hard filters -> token matching and ranking -> shared response envelope.

behavior.normalization: Unicode case folding and accent removal, punctuation tokenization, small English stop-word list, explicit product synonym map, deduplicated query tokens.
behavior.matching: Every meaningful query token must match a catalog token. Exact/canonical synonym strength 1, prefix 0.8 for query length >=3, typo strength 0.65 when SequenceMatcher ratio >=0.8 and both tokens have length >=4.
behavior.ranking: Best weighted match per query token, summed: name weight 3, category and tags weight 2, description weight 1. Stable tie-break on product id; price sorts use relevance then id.
behavior.empty_query: Whitespace-only query browses filtered products. Nonblank punctuation-only or stop-word-only queries return no results.
behavior.fixtures: All shipped catalog entries and tests are synthetic.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clock-based ranking, external data, LLM calls, or mutable state.

test_outcomes.suite: 13 unittest cases including normal, edge, invalid-input and CLI behavior
test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: one JSON object with status ok and one matching synthetic running-shoe product.
